name: Org 12962
summary: ORG-12962 is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the pyridinylpiperazine family which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder but was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: ORG-12962 is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the pyridinylpiperazine family which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder but was never marketed. It acts preferentially as a partial agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor (Ki = 12 nM; EC50 = 97.7 nM; Emax = 62%).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2C receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.text: ORG-12962 is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the pyridinylpiperazine family which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder but was never marketed. It was developed by Organon. The drug reached phase 2 clinical trials for depression prior to the discontinuation of its development.
